valuation: Local-currency observations use the dated official reference FX in statistics.json where available. Unsupported currencies retain an explicitly LOW annual-average fallback. An updated FX does not refresh the tariff observation period. Ranges describe tariffs/applicability, not probability intervals.

observations.scope: MME/ANEEL billed industrial electricity, national and macro-regional averages; regulated supply, not a free-market PPA. Macro-regions do not resolve state/network tariffs.
observations.method: MME Informativo Tarifario, 1st semester 2026, table 7, p.38; local R$/MWh divided by 1000 and BRL/EUR.

observations.scope: Manufacturing at 22 to below 110 kV, excluding VAT. Continuous weekly consumption is an explicit reference profile, not a measured customer load.
observations.method: Decision 1279/QD-BCT: normal/off-peak/peak rates weighted by 96/42/30 hours per week. Subsequent timing changes preserve these weekly totals; a customer bill/load profile overrides the reference.

observations.scope: PEA medium/large general service TOU, 22-33 kV, excluding VAT. Reference 500 kW/200 MWh per month, continuous load; public holidays and transformer losses are excluded.
observations.method: Published PEA TOU energy rates + current Ft; add demand and service charges for the stated reference. Self-generation only avoids the energy/Ft portion; no peak-demand reduction is assumed.

observations.scope: BOT/NSO average monthly employee wage, not a specialist biogas operator quotation.
observations.method: Monthly wage x12 x1.05 employer allowance /2200 hours /THB per EUR. Employer allowance and working hours are engineering assumptions.

observations.scope: Energosbyt Almaty non-household group 2, excluding VAT. Applicable reference for the Almaty region only; special industrial/food producer group is 39.30 KZT/kWh.
observations.method: Published local tariff /KZT per EUR. Outside Almaty this is a regional proxy and remains LOW until a local tariff or customer bill is supplied.
